headline: Public hearing on Eversource petition to install conduits on Stockbridge Street.
summary: The request would run from PAD 1487/2-2P southwest down Stockbridge Street. The conduits would serve the Colonial and Clock Tower Buildings.
items: Eversource petition to install eight 4-inch conduits and a secondary service cable from PAD 1487/2-2P
Route goes southwest down Stockbridge Street, onto private property at 21 Stockbridge Street and behind 11 Stockbridge Street
Conduits to sit on the roadway against the existing curb
plain_text:
Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 11/13/2026 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can 
be acted upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Monday, November 30, 2026 at 
3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
Stockbridge Street 
 
Petitions 
To install eight (8) 4” conduits and a secondary service cable from PAD 1487/2-2P, proceed 
south-west down Stockbridge St and enter private property 21 Stockbridge Street and property 
behind 11 Stockbridge Street. The conduits will be located on the roadway against the existing 
curb. The conduits are used for service to the Colonial and Clock Tower Buildings.  
 1. Eversource - Stockbridge St.
